content.comment_body: Hello all, I'm experiencing an issue as shown in the attached image. I am unable to transfer the program to the [product_name] controller.

Hello, If the program is copy protected, there are two options: 1. Enter the password if one has been set. 2. If you don't know the password or it's not set, remove the card. This will erase the program from the [product_name] and allow normal operation. Be sure not to use a card with copy protection unless you have formatted it. Once formatted, the memory card can be used without restrictions. You can find more details in the [product_name] manual. Hope this helps.
I resolved the issue by updating the software to [version_no], and the problem no longer occurs.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced program download issues due to copy protection tied to an SD card in a [company_name] [product_name] controller. The root cause was the card's copy protection feature. Updating to the latest version of the control software addressed the problem, suggesting previous software releases had compatibility or feature limitations when handling protected storage.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated seamless program transfers to the controller, without security restrictions imposed by protected SD cards or software limitations.
